description: Shared Renovate preset for the chri5bot, cybergarden-team and TechDevStudio repositories. Low-noise defaults: one weekly grouped PR for non-major updates, majors behind Dependency Dashboard approval, no automerge while CI runs locally.

schedule: before 7am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Major updates are listed on the Dependency Dashboard and only get a PR once approved there.
GitHub Actions bumps are grouped on their own so a workflow change never mixes with runtime dependencies.
